sources.name: GitHub issue trackers (REST search via gh api, full threads via the issues and comments endpoints)
defects: sample 'crash modpack' (20 issues): 20/20 on topic, but 17/20 Minecraft, so the source skews to Minecraft modpacks over Bethesda heavy setups
logs offloaded to external pastes (mclo.gs, gist, pastebin, gnomebot, p.kdan.dev) in 9/20; pastes can expire, so the data a report carried may no longer be reachable
forced issue templates leave '_No response_' fields in 6/20; the player's own words are often one line inside a template
1/20 author shown as 'ghost' (deleted account)
5/20 dated before 2023; older reports describe tool versions since replaced

2026 issues increasingly carry AI-written analyses and some repos are written by AI agents end to end (seen in roughly 1 in 10 Skyrim crash issues read and in most 'nexus api' results); only the person's own lines are cited
one tracker per repo; counted here as one family (GitHub issue trackers) so that several repos never make a second family

sources.name: Hacker News (Algolia search API and Firebase item API, read through WebFetch)
defects: sample 'mod crash' comments (20): 4/20 on game mods; 16/20 off topic (hardware mods, cars, browsers)
story titles sometimes '[dead]'; one hit was a pasted Nexus announcement (context, not evidence)
comment tree fetches (items endpoint) are truncated by the fetch tool, so a fetch that reports no matching comments is not evidence of silence; such searches are marked unreliable in the trails
dates are per comment and reliable; text verified through the Firebase item endpoint

sources.name: Lemmy/threadiverse (lemmy.world search API, per-comment API on the origin instance)
defects: sample 'modding discord' comments (20): 6/20 use 'modding' to mean moderating
instances die: lemmyonline.com no longer serves comments (lemmy.world copies used), lemmy.one returned 522, kbin.social is gone
'guilded' searches return mostly 'gilded age' misspellings (18/20 off topic)
search results read through a summarizing model truncate content; every cited comment was re-fetched from the per-comment endpoint

sources.name: Steam Community discussions (read through WebFetch)
defects: three threads read (about 25 posts); two fetches returned only the page chrome (Skyrim app 72850 threads) so the Skyrim forum stayed out of reach
the fetch tool summarizes posts; one first-hand passage was re-fetched for exact text
most replies in the sampled threads were advice or second-hand recollection rather than first-hand accounts

sources.name: STEP Modifications forum (read through WebFetch)
defects: two threads read (16 posts); search pages not fetched, threads found through web search

the fetch tool invented a post: its first summary of thread 20025 gave z929669 a Sept 23 reply ('Perhaps. Maybe report it on that mod page') that the string-check showed is not on the page; every STEP quote cited was string-checked
logs linked off-site

sources.name: Roblox DevForum (Discourse JSON, read through WebFetch)
defects: two topics read (about 24 posts of 223); only the first page of the 221-post announcement topic was reached
voices are Roblox creators who used Guilded, not modding groups
many posts are one-line farewells without an experience

sources.name: EndeavourOS forum (Discourse JSON)
defects: one topic, 7 posts; a Linux project community, not a modding group

sources.name: General web search (WebSearch)
defects: returns a model summary plus links; summaries were used only to find places, never cited
many hits are SEO or AI-written pages (Discord-alternative listicles, 'how much does CurseForge pay' explainers); none cited
press articles quote authors (Arthmoor, 2021) second-hand; kept as context

sources.name: WebFetch path (all non-GitHub pages)
defects: passes pages through a small model that paraphrases, inserts ellipses, and once invented a post; every cited quote from this path was either fetched from a per-item API in exact form or string-checked in a second fetch

sources.name: Reddit (r/skyrimmods, r/feedthebeast and others)
defects: unreachable: WebFetch is refused for reddit.com, redlib/libreddit mirrors returned 403 or TLS errors, arctic-shift returned 422, and a direct network fetch needs the operator's approval; the largest player and author community is therefore absent from this record

sources.name: Nexus Mods site and forums
defects: unreachable: every page returned 403; mod-page posts tabs, author About pages and the 2021 announcement comments are absent

sources.name: Discord servers
defects: not searchable from outside; the place where much mod support now happens (see Q14) is invisible to this record

sources.name: eavesdrop corpus
defects: not used: under refactor and not trustworthy as of 2026-10-05 (threaded replies misattributed), per the run instructions
